description: Header file defining the Messenger class for a plugin, including interfaces, notification and callback classes, and JSON-RPC methods for room and message management within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: Messenger
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing messaging and room notification interfaces, managing room states, and handling JSON-RPC endpoints.

classes.name: MsgNotification
classes.description: Notification class for message events within a room.

classes.name: Callback
classes.description: Callback class for user join/leave events within a room.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given service shell.

methods.name: JoinRoom
methods.description: Joins a specified room with a user name.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a specified room.

methods.name: UserJoinedHandler
methods.description: Handles a user joining a room.

methods.name: UserLeftHandler
methods.description: Handles a user leaving a room.

methods.name: MessageHandler
methods.description: Handles an incoming message in a room.
